artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the spin-1/2 ferromagnetic XXZ Hamiltonian on a chain
$$H = J_0 \sum_{k} \big(\sigma^x_k \sigma^x_{k+1} + \sigma^y_k \sigma^y_{k+1} + \Delta\, \sigma^z_k \sigma^z_{k+1}\big),$$
restricted to the sector of fixed total magnetization with average value $\bar m \in (-1,1)$. In the massless (gapless) phase $-1 < \Delta \le 1$, the ground-state connected longitudinal correlation function admits the large-distance expansion
$$\langle \sigma^z_0 \sigma^z_n\rangle_c = \frac{c_1(\Delta,\bar m)}{n^2} + (\text{subleading oscillatory terms}),$$
where $c_1(\Delta,\bar m)$ is the universal amplitude of the non-oscillating $1/n^2$ part.

Determine whether, for every fixed $\bar m \in (-1,1)$, the amplitude satisfies the asymptotic equivalence
$$c_1(\Delta,\bar m) \;\underset{\Delta \to -1^+}{\sim}\; -\frac{1}{\pi}\sqrt{\frac{1-\bar m^2}{2(1+\Delta)}}.$$
That is, prove or disprove that this limiting form (which generalizes the known half-filling result $\bar m = 0$) holds as $\Delta$ approaches $-1$ from above for arbitrary fixed magnetization in $(-1,1)$.
artifact.status_search_result: The statement is presented as a conjecture extrapolating a half-filling Luttinger-liquid amplitude to arbitrary fixed magnetization in the limit Δ → −1⁺. Web searches turned up no proof or disproof of this magnetization-dependent asymptotic for the c₁ amplitude; known exact results (Lukyanov–Zamolodchikov) give the amplitude at general Δ in the massless phase but the explicit Δ → −1⁺ behavior at arbitrary $\bar m$ does not appear to have been rigorously established.

status_evidence.title: Correlation amplitude and entanglement entropy in random spin chains
status_evidence.snippet: Correlation amplitudes in XXZ chains were derived by Lukyanov and Zamolodchikov and later checked numerically.
status_evidence.claim: Existing exact results address general Δ in the massless phase but the conjectured Δ→−1⁺ form at arbitrary magnetization is not stated as proven.

status_evidence.title: Proximate Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid in a spin-1/2 ferromagnetic XXZ chain compound
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of ferromagnetic XXZ near Δ = −1 and Luttinger-liquid behavior.
status_evidence.claim: Recent literature continues to study the regime Δ → −1⁺ without quoting a proof of the conjectured amplitude.
